mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1400 thousand units indicates robust residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1400 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high employment growth (PAYEMS > 135,000 thousand) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.6%) indicate a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.6%.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 110), declining manufacturing output increases input costs and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 200 indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: A residential fixed investment level above 350,000 million dollars indicates strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) indicate a delayed monetary response to inflation, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), weak labor market conditions reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.
